title: Research amateur station and site eligibility
description:
Assemble primary Part 97 requirements for station/operator eligibility, proposed sites, sharing obligations, permitted emissions and power. Include 97.303 33-cm geographic restrictions and complete emission envelopes, not just channel centers. Record missing operator or location information without inventing it.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Read-only research, not station authorization or licensing selection. Do not request licenses, contact coordinators, inspect physical devices or turn an existing Part 15 deployment into an amateur deployment. Human emission/control review is narrow.06.
acceptance_criteria: A clause-backed applicability table identifies known, excluded and unresolved site/configuration cases. Independently checked geographic boundary examples distinguish restricted segments and areas. Include minimum necessary power and applicable SS limits without assuming a blanket 1500 W allowance.
